$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\int \frac{4}{1+4{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x & =4\int \frac{1}{1+(2x)^{2}}\text{d}x \\  & =4\int \frac{1}{1+{u}^{2}}\cdot (\frac{1}{2}\text{d}u) \\  & =2\int \frac{1}{1+{u}^{2}}\text{d}u \\  & =2\operatorname{arctan}⁡u+C \\  & =2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2x)+C\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
